船大工がいると、航海中に船を修理してもらえます。造船所での修理の費用も安く済みます。

主計室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
艦隊の会計を行う部屋です。
配置した航海士は「主計長」になります。配置できるのは、会計術 100以上の航海士です。
主計長がいると、交易所で値段をまけてもらえることがあります。また、倍の金額を出せば、商品を買い占められたりもします。ただし、倍の値段では売れません。
records.source_meaning: Accountant requires accounting>=100. May obtain trade-house discounts; may buy out stock at twice price; cannot sell at twice price. No unconditional discount/buyout claim.
records.heading: Purser's Office
records.english: The fleet's accounts are managed here. Officers assigned here become Pursers and need Finance 100 or higher. A Purser may get you lower prices at the Trade House. You may also be able to buy up all available stock by paying twice the price, but you cannot sell at twice the price.
records.speaker: Help narrator
records.context: Read with the complete connected Common Commands/Deck/assignments/rooms/holds exchange, source103 through133, plus linked role and movement explanations.
records.localization_note: The source benefit applies at the Trade House, not the separate Market Info service. Retain the conditional discount/buyout wording and explicit inability to sell for twice the price.
